evidence: TI section9.2 example gives3.2mV/us slew at3.6V for C variant. Current PCB BOM uses C, not faster B variant.
screen_conditions: Typical example at3.6V, not guaranteed3.3V worst-case. External output capacitance only; card internal capacitance and active startup load excluded.
decision: Do not increase C27 solely to buffer writes: larger capacitance increases switch-on demand. C variant provides slew control, not a hard50mA battery current limit. Final C27 value requires exact card startup/write waveform and effective-capacitance qualification.
remaining: Card internal capacitance and startup current
